answers.rationale: The requirement specifies technical parameters for metal-clad switchgear, including short-circuit current, MVA class, and interrupting ratings. The CROWN-ARMV product is the appropriate choice as it is designed for metal-clad MV switchgear with similar specifications.
The requirement describes features of circuit breakers, which are components of metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product includes vacuum breakers and is suitable for this requirement.
The low-frequency test voltage is a specification for metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is designed to meet such technical requirements.
The basic impulse level is a standard specification for metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is engineered to meet these standards.
The nominal voltage supplies and ranges are part of the specifications for the switchgear's operational requirements. The CROWN-ARMV product is suitable for these parameters.
